label: OpenAI Codex CLI

skills.note: Codex scans .agents/skills (NOT .codex/skills). The same tree is read by Gemini CLI and Cursor, so one directory serves three tools.

trust_note: Codex requires you to trust a command hook before it runs, and re-arms that gate whenever the hook's definition changes. Run /hooks in Codex and approve DDW's, or the pipeline is advisory only.
